rationale: Several switchboard frames show pliers-like hand tools in use, while a wrench is clearly visible mainly in the later pipe-work frames. evidence_refs: frames 100.000, 380.000 and 457.000s: pliers-like tools used at the electrical panel
frames 1372.000 and 1387.000s: wrench used during later pipe fitting rather than a visible switchboard-floor pickup
missing_key_evidence: Continuous or event-level evidence counting every pliers and wrench pickup from the floor during the switchboard-fixing interval.
